Owl’s Science Graduation

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill The grand science challenge

Plant growth, animal habitat, sink or float — solve all three puzzles and graduate!

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · THE GRAND SCIENCE CHALLENGE

Owl’s Science Graduation

The final science challenge! Solve all three puzzles to graduate from Owl’s Science Lab!

Puzzle 1: the seed grew into a sprout. What comes next?

Puzzle 2: where does this polar bear live?

Puzzle 3: this toy boat is put in water. What happens?

SCIENCE GRADUATE!

Three puzzles solved — plants grow, polar bears live on ice, and boats float. Hooray for you, scientist!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

A grand-finale mix: growth sequencing, habitat matching and floating logic — the whole class in three questions. Celebrate loudly; graduation caps are mandatory.

Illustration note: Loaded by content: the file named foxes-compass-adventure actually carries this Owl’s Science Graduation artwork (the R2 export shifted files 20–30 by one slot). The three puzzles revisit earlier Class 31 skills.

Prefer paper? The Owl’s Science Graduation worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
